label: neiso 20 ct deploy2x
definition: neiso 20 (PROBE — rejected; negative control for the CT wedge). Baseline (neiso 17) + --ct-deployment-floor-frac 2.0: doubles the measured sub-marginal CT AS/RUC-deployment floor (0.08->0.15 TWh of forced energy). CT_PEAKER TWh (model / EIA-923 %): 0.113 -73% / 0.066 -90% / 0.096 -81% (2023/24/25) vs baseline 0.084/0.052/0.079 — barely moves (the sub-marginal slice is nearly exhausted at frac 1.0). CC_REGULAR unchanged at +8.7% in 2025 (-0.2/-0.3% in 2023/24, no regression, no improvement). Confirms the candidate-B contrast: the observed-energy reserve wedge (neiso 19 ct-mustrun, CT 0.27-0.36) is ~2-3x the sub-marginal deployment slice; scaling the slice is a dead end. Does nothing for the headline CC over-dispatch.
